subject: DayZero: Sanity run witness and operational certification
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.company
To: irene_choi@redwood.company, marissa_cole@redwood.company, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.company
Cc: 
Date: 2025-10-05T07:18:00Z
Subject: DayZero: Sanity run witness and operational certification

Team —

This is the DayZero checklist and witness plan for the Acme private deployment cutover tomorrow (10/05). Goal: run through the acceptance runbook, validate networking & routing, and capture the minimal observability evidence set so we can sign off green-path. Key asks:

- Irene: lead control-plane validation and BGP/peering checks (Steps 2.1–2.6).
- Vivek: run the KV priming and prefix cache verification (Steps 3.1–3.5).
- Marissa: own smoke traffic, SLA probes, and rollback triggers.

Attached: dayzero_runbook_v3.pdf (runbook with step IDs). I kicked off a read-only Drive folder for screenshots and logs: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/Acme-DayZero-20251005

Minimum acceptance criteria (must all be true for green):
1) Control-plane: all BGP sessions established, no suppressed prefixes, route acceptance matches policy.
2) Data-plane: 95%+ prefix warmup, KV cache hit-rate >= 60% baseline.
3) Observability: no new P1/P0 alerts for 30m, token p95 latency <= 180ms.
4) Rollback: documented, tested, and <15m execution estimate.

Please reply with your readiness status and any outstanding gating items. I will host the ops bridge at 09:30 PT — zoom link in Drive.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Cloud Operations
Redwood Inference
From: irene_choi@redwood.company
To: jonas_weber@redwood.company, marissa_cole@redwood.company, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.company
Cc: 
Date: 2025-10-05T08:02:00Z
Subject: Re: DayZero: Sanity run witness and operational certification

Jonas —

I've reviewed dayzero_runbook_v3.pdf. A few tactical notes before we start:

- Step 2.2 (BGP session audit): I will run bgpmon against all three peering racks. Expect ~30s per peer to validate session state and RIB walk.
- MTU check: Found one edge NIC with MTU set to 1500 on Acme side in the staging snapshot; we need confirmation that production peers are 9000 or we will see fragmentation. I added a quick MTU probe to Step 2.3.
- ACLs: I will test explicit control-plane allow-list (TCP/179 from Acme edge) and verify port 22 access for the oncall bastion.

I attached a short checklist (in the runbook) and will upload the bgp dump + MTU probe output to the Drive folder as evidence.

Attachments: [attachment: runbook_patch_notes.txt (text)]

Irene Choi
Principal Network Engineer
Redwood Inference

All —

Readiness quick-check:
- My test harness (synthetic traffic) is staged and will start at 09:45 PT. It will hit the new VPC /on-prem edge and run the smoke suite (auth, generation, embeddings sample, KV read/write).
- If we see token p95 > 200ms persistently for 5 minutes I will trigger rollback.
- Rollback plan v2 is attached and rehearsed in the DR session yesterday; estimated termination-to-failover ~12 minutes once initiated.

I'll post the first smoke evidence (screenshots + curl logs) to the Drive folder and tag the ticket.

Subject: Re: DayZero: Sanity run witness and operational certification — closure

Team —

Thank you. Quick closure: we executed the runbook from 10:00–10:35 PT. Highlights (evidence uploaded to Drive):
- BGP: three peering sessions established, RIB acceptance matched policy; pcap and bgpdump uploaded (drive/pcap_and_bgp/).
- MTU: confirmed 9000 end-to-end; no fragmentation seen in sample pcap.
- KV priming: prefix warmup reached 97% in 18 minutes; KV cache hit-rate recorded 64% at T+30. Evidence: obs-evidence-20251005.tar.gz uploaded.
- Smoke tests: synthetic suite passed with token p95 = 145ms; no P1 alerts fired during 40m window.
- Rollback: not required. Rollback runbook validated as workable with <12m execution in dry-run.

Sign-off: Green-path certified for handoff to CS/Onboarding. I will archive the evidence bundle to the customer folder and update the ticket.

Thanks to everyone for crisp execution. Please leave any postmortem notes in the Drive folder; we'll capture a short runbook delta for v4.

Jonas Weber
Director, Cloud Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: [attachment: obs-evidence-20251005.tar.gz (tgz)]
